{"subject":"Congrats on $100M ARR","body":"Hi there,

Congratulations on tripling ARR to $100 million in a year, as TechCrunch reported in February. Add fourfold revenue growth in 2025 and $392 million raised as of June 30, and it's a remarkable run for the Clay team.

If it would be useful, I'd welcome a 20-minute call to hear what you're focused on next and where we might be helpful. No agenda beyond that.

Jordan"}
